p: the end of the earth will: From the place where I was banished, being driven out of the city and temple by my son Absalom.
higher than I: To which without your help I cannot attain.
hast heard my vows: There is nothing that strengthens our faith more than the memory of God's help in times past.
life: This chiefly refers to Christ, who lives eternally not only in himself but also in his members.
mercy and truth: For the stability of my kingdom stands in your mercy and truth.
